title: CDISC USDM v4.0.0 Wrapper (input) schema
$comment: Vendored test fixture. Extracted from the official CDISC DDF-RA USDM v4.0.0 OpenAPI 3.1 document (Deliverables/API/USDM_API.json, info.version 4.0.0, tag v4.0.0). Two mechanical changes only: (1) just the request-body ('-Input') schemas under components.schemas are kept, because those are what a USDM document is validated against; the '-Output' twins, HTTPValidationError, ValidationError, paths and tags are dropped; (2) '#/components/schemas/' refs are rewritten to '#/$defs/'. Every '-Input' schema is present and unchanged. Root is the USDM Wrapper. Licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2022 CDISC; full text in x-license.
